title: Lost in a Few Heads: Diagnosing and Repairing Block Selection in Sparse Attention
abstract: arXiv:2611.21917v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Sparse attention models read a few blocks of keys for every query at a fixed budget and can lose much of their long-context retrieval accuracy at that budget. We ask where this loss is made. Using exact attention mass selection at the shipped budget as an oracle, we show that the selector under-ranks the needle rather than running out of budget. We find attention heads that miss the needle by running a calibration probe that teacher-forces the answer and reads two quantities in every head. The first is the needle attention that the selector forfeits, and the second is the share of the answer's log-probability that fixing the head's selection restores, integrated along the path from the shipped selector to full attention. Four checkpoints of the InfLLM-V2 family and NOSA-8B lose multi-key retrieval in the same three blind heads, which attend to the needle while a mean-pooled key summary dilutes its single decisive token. translated_title: 迷失在少数注意力头中：诊断与修复稀疏注意力中的块选择
translated_abstract: 稀疏注意力模型在固定预算下为每个查询只读取少量键块，因此在该预算下可能损失大量长上下文检索准确率。我们探究这种损失究竟发生在哪里。以出厂预算下的精确注意力质量选择作为预言机，我们证明选择器的问题在于对“针”（关键信息）的排序偏低，而非预算耗尽。我们通过运行一个校准探针来找出错过关键信息的注意力头：该探针以教师强制方式输入答案，并读取每个注意力头中的两个量。第一个是选择器所放弃的关键信息注意力，第二个是修复该头的选择后能恢复的答案对数概率份额，该份额沿从出厂选择器到全注意力的路径进行积分。InfLLM-V2 系列的四个检查点以及 NOSA-8B 都在相同的三个“盲”注意力头上丢失了多键检索能力，这些头虽然本会关注关键信息，但平均池化的键摘要稀释了其中单个决定性 token。
tldr: 该论文提出一种校准探针方法，诊断出稀疏注意力的长上下文检索损失源于少数“盲”注意力头——其平均池化的键摘要稀释了关键 token 导致排序偏低而非预算不足，并在 InfLLM-V2 与 NOSA-8B 中验证了这一现象。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces a calibration probe revealing that sparse attention's long-context retrieval loss stems from a few "blind" heads—where mean-pooled key summaries dilute the needle's decisive token and cause under-ranking rather than budget exhaustion—consistently across InfLLM-V2 checkpoints and NOSA-8B.
